about: Media key: hero videos, legibility statistics and blind structure recovery, all from fresh VW-1 runs (aworld.MapWorld on the JAX Flow-Lenia port; VW-0 analysis/drawing helpers used read-only on VW-1 outputs).

hero_episode.api: World.reset(0) then World.step(None) x 300 (agent API); level 0 and level 1 from designer.state() of the same episode

fusion_example.note: slot 0 (mass 277, about 1.9 median glider masses; itself formed by a fusion at tick 83) merges with slot 8 (423) into a 700-mass curved worm; at tick 96 a 137-mass piece (about one glider) buds off as slot 1 and slot 8 keeps 563; at tick 97 slot 8 absorbs slot 3 and sheds two more pieces (171, 105). Do not caption it 'a glider fuses with body 8 ... splits again'.

same_hidden_episode_across_views.note: same world_seed and reset seed => same hidden trajectory and same hidden input permutation in every view
same_hidden_episode_across_views.status: not a new leak: the checker's VW-0 finding (companion worlds with one world seed share the input permutation) persists in VW-1. VW-1's key change separates different world seeds only (checker control: world_seed 1 gives a different level 0 and in_map). It matters only if one agent is given two views with one world seed.
same_hidden_episode_across_views.checker_reproduction: check/rerun.json: coarse world re-run in a new process, level 0 identical to the saved objects episode for 61 ticks

legibility.rubric_verdict: I Supported (7-8 bodies, mean 7.4, no births or deaths, bodies persist through identity churn); M Supported (98% of tracks living >= 50 ticks travel >= 3 body lengths, median 7.8; known Flow-Lenia gliders, novelty 0); X Weak (fusion 22.5 and fission 22.3 per 100 ticks, 63% of encounters fuse within 5 ticks, no matched ablation, merges = splits); D absent (fission without growth: mass conserved to 2e-14 relative, so splitting is fragmentation); S not met (planted noise patches)

anonymisation.episode: one fresh agent episode per view: World.reset(0), World.step(None) x 300 (301 observations)
